Dear Larkspur team,

I am writing to express my interest in hiring your Hartwell for a period drama shoot. We would like to pick it up on 30/08/2027 at 8:30 am and bring it back on 2nd September 2027 at 09:00, whereupon it will be collected from your garage. I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Sincerely,
Victor Wintermere, +70 478 642 5723
